info.name: padam
info.note: mriyaterluNliNoSca 1.3.61 ityanena kevalaM sArvaDAtukapratyayezu parezu, taTA ca ASIrliNlakAre luNlakAre ca pare asmAt DAtoH Atmanepadasya pratyayAH Bavanti . anyezu ArDaDAtukapratyayezu parezu asmAt DAtoH parasmEpadasyEva pratyayAH viDIyate .

examples: 'pramriyamARe vA rAjanyamAtyaH kulyakumAramuKyAn …vikrAmayet' (kO0 a0 5.6.2.25). pramriyamARe AsannamaraRe.

'guruRABimftA anyato vA'pakzIyamARAH' (ASva0 gf0 4.7.1). yezu jIvatsu gururmriyate te guruRABimftAH. dvO carABimarO spaSO (ityamaraH). aBimriyata ityaBimaraH. prARanirapekzastIkzRAKyaH, yo dravyaheto rvyAlaM vA hastinaM vA yoDayatIti svAmI.
'taM ha paYca rAjAnaH parimamruH' (E0 brA0 8.28). paritaH sarvadikzu vartamAnA dvizanto rAjAno mamrurityarTaH.
'cirAt kzatrasyAstu pralaya iva GoraH parimaraH' (mahAvIra0 3.41) parimaro vyApI vinASaH, aBivyApakaM kadanam.
'tad brahmaRaH parimara ityupAsIta' (tE0 u0 3.10.4). parito mriyante'neneti parimaro vAyuH.
